description: Statistics Norway's population on 1 January and the year's births, deaths and migration for the whole country, a county or a municipality, 1951 to the latest year. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

region.description: 0 for Norway, a 2-digit county or a 4-digit municipality number, e.g. 0301 for Oslo.

year.description: Year, YYYY. Default: the latest year.

name: get_population
title: Population of a municipality, county or Norway
